APPROVE

The extracted `CompareSegment` keeps the same int/int, string/string and mixed-case branches and returns identical values, and the loop's `c != 0` early return is unchanged. This removes the if/else-if/else chain and the `&&` conditions from `Compare`, so its cognitive complexity drops well below 15. I saw nothing that should break the build, since the new private static method is used and the `object` parameter types match what the loop's ternaries produce. I could only review the diff, not build it or check for an existing `CompareSegment` name.
